#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
ll modular_inverse(ll a, ll m) {
	assert(m > 0);
	if (m == 1) return 0;
	a %= m;
	if (a < 0) a += m;
	assert(a != 0);
	if (a == 1) return 1;
	return m - modular_inverse(m, a) * m / a;
}

template <int MOD_> struct ModularNumber {
private:
	int value;
public:
	static const int MOD = MOD_;

	ModularNumber() : value(0) {}
	ModularNumber(ll v_) : value(int(v_ % MOD)) { if (value < 0) value += MOD; }
	explicit operator int () const { return value; }
	friend bool operator == (const ModularNumber& a, const ModularNumber& b) { return a.value == b.value; }
	friend bool operator != (const ModularNumber& a, const ModularNumber& b) { return a.value != b.value; }

	ModularNumber operator ~ () const {
		ModularNumber res;
		res.value = modular_inverse(value, MOD);
		return res;
	}

	ModularNumber& operator += (const ModularNumber& o) {
		value += o.value;
		if (value >= MOD) value -= MOD;
		return *this;
	}
	ModularNumber& operator -= (const ModularNumber& o) {
		value -= o.value;
		if (value < 0) value += MOD;
		return *this;
	}
	ModularNumber& operator *= (const ModularNumber& o) {
		value = int(ll(value) * ll(o.value) % MOD);
		return *this;
	}
	ModularNumber& operator /= (const ModularNumber& o) {
		return *this *= (~o);
	}

	friend ModularNumber operator + (const ModularNumber& a, const ModularNumber& b) { return ModularNumber(a) += b; }
	friend ModularNumber operator - (const ModularNumber& a, const ModularNumber& b) { return ModularNumber(a) -= b; }
	friend ModularNumber operator * (const ModularNumber& a, const ModularNumber& b) { return ModularNumber(a) *= b; }
	friend ModularNumber operator / (const ModularNumber& a, const ModularNumber& b) { return ModularNumber(a) /= b; }
};

using num_type = ModularNumber<int(1e9)+7>;

int main() {
	ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0), cin.tie(0), cout.tie(0);
	const int n = 6;
	vector<vector<num_type>> p(n, vector<num_type>(n, 0));
	int _n;
	cin >> _n;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i][i] = 1;
	for (int i = 0; i < _n; i++) {
		for (int j = 0; j < _n; j++) {
			int a;
			cin >> a;
			p[i][j] = num_type(a) / num_type(100);
		}
	}
	const int f = 20;
	vector<vector<num_type>> sets(2, vector<num_type>(1 << f, 0));
	vector<vector<int>> masks(2);
	for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
			for (int k = 0; k < j; k++) {
				masks[0].push_back((1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k));
				masks[1].push_back(((1 << n) - 1) ^ masks[0].back());
			}
		}
	}
	assert(f == (int)masks[0].size());
	for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
		for (int e = 0; e < (1 << (n / 2 * n)); e++) {
			num_type prob = 1;
			int edges[n / 2];
			for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) edges[i] = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < n / 2 * n; i++) {
				bool r = (e >> i) & 1;
				num_type pp = p[(i / n) * 2 + t][i % n];
				prob *= r ? pp : (1 - pp);
				edges[i / n] |= int(r) << (i % n);
			}
			int work_mask = 0;
			for (int a = 0; a < (int)masks[t].size(); a++) {
				int mask = masks[t][a];
				int r[n / 2];
				for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) r[i] = edges[i] & mask;
				if (r[0] && r[1] && r[2]) {
					if (__builtin_popcount(r[0] | r[1] | r[2]) == 3) {
						int x = __builtin_popcount(r[0] | r[1]);
						int y = __builtin_popcount(r[0] | r[2]);
						int z = __builtin_popcount(r[1] | r[2]);
						if (x >= 2 && y >= 2 && z >= 2) {
							work_mask |= (1 << a);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			sets[t][work_mask] += prob;
		}
	}
	for (int i = 0; i < f; i++) {
		for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
			if ((j >> i) & 1) continue;
			sets[0][j ^ (1 << i)] += sets[0][j];
		}
	}
	num_type answer = 0;
	for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
		answer += sets[0][j] * sets[1][((1 << f) - 1) ^ j];
	}
	answer = 1 - answer;
	cout << (int)answer << '\n';
